rubric.allowed_sources: Restaurant's official website/Instagram/press kit; its Resy/OpenTable/SevenRooms/Tock listing; editorial press photos credited to the restaurant or its photographer. Never Beli member photos, Yelp/Google/TripAdvisor user uploads, blogs, or uncredited/staff editorial photos.

criteria.identity: 0-3: 3 = unmistakably this exact dish/drink (caption, filename or obvious); 2 = very likely; 1 = plausible/ambiguous; 0 = not the dish
criteria.authority: 0-3: 3 = official site/IG/press kit; 2 = booking-platform listing; 1 = editorial photo credited to restaurant or its photographer; 0 = disallowed
criteria.resolution: 0-3: >=1200px wide = 3; >=800 = 2; >=500 = 1; else 0 (measured from the downloaded file)
criteria.composition: 0-3: in focus, dish fills frame, well lit = 3; dark/tiny/cluttered = 0-1 (judged by viewing the image)
criteria.recency: 0-1: 1 if evidently <= 2 years old (upload-path date, page date, or on current menu)

rubric.keep: top-scoring photo per item as best + up to 2 runners_up; best=null with photo_note when no allowed photo exists
rubric.verification: every kept URL re-checked 2026-11-21 with a plain GET: HTTP 200 + image/* content type (79/79 passed)
